WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    record_count,
    CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(record_count) FROM status_counts) AS share
  FROM status_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM with_shares
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    record_count,
    share,
    share - av.avg_share AS share_excess
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN avg_share av
  WHERE share > av.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(record_count) AS avg_count,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(share_excess) AS avg_share_excess
FROM filtered
